comment: No voucher at all, on an individual's book with no previous-year turnover recorded. tds_payees gives the deductor status 'unknown' and its question, with no payee row; partners_40b_194t does not apply to an individual. The caller assembles no row, so tds_interest_201 publishes its 17 fixed figures (the as-of date, the three rates, the totals and the counts, all totals and counts 0) and no finding.
